text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As an eldest daughter, Ines Fujin feels a lot of responsibility for her family. Even while training for the races she loves so much, she works part-time jobs to support her little sisters' dreams as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling guilty for indulging in her desire to race, she works hard for her family, and to fund her sisters' dance lessons.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin tells me she wants to continue working part-time jobs even after her debut in the Twinkle Series. It seems she's determined to keep doing her best both on the track and at work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The path ahead might get tough, but she doesn't want to neglect any of the things that matter to her. I swear that I'll do all I can to support her!
